change_summary: Cut Oya VCS from planned substrate to forward Foundry agentic closure authority and close the first follow-up loop: oya-dev-cli now exposes claim/done/promote ratchet commands, admission requires provider evidence slots, targeted VCS tests remain blocking, and multispectrum evidence must be audit-chain covered.

commands: cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- vcs --format json claim --agent codex-oya-vcs-followup --intent "implement Oya VCS CLI admission follow-up" crates/oya-dev-cli/src/commands/vcs.rs::OyaVcsCli
cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- vcs --format json done --agent codex-oya-vcs-followup --evidence evidence/gitops-vcs/oya-vcs-admission-cutover-2026-05-15.json

cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- vcs --format json promote --agent codex-oya-vcs-followup --bundle bundle_oya_vcs_admission_cutover --environment ci-preview --evidence evidence/gitops-vcs/oya-vcs-admission-cutover-2026-05-15.json
cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- vcs --format json verify --agent codex-oya-vcs-followup --evidence evidence/gitops-vcs/oya-vcs-admission-cutover-2026-05-15.json
mechanical_proof.authority_checks: root quick-start, master sequencing, multispectrum agentic flow, gitops admission gates, branch protection, workflow, provider evidence slots, audit-chain coverage, VCS package presence, and CLI claim/verify/done/promote smoke all passed
mechanical_proof.provider_evidence_slots: ci, github-actions, trivy, argo-gitops slots recorded in gitops evidence and checked by admission gate
mechanical_proof.audit_chain_coverage: admission gate requires every multispectrum evidence change_id to appear in evidence/audit-chain.jsonl

findings: Deleted the stale M02/M03 waiver path instead of adding another parallel exception; Oya VCS is now one closure path.
Admission script is narrow and targeted; full scripts/check.sh now delegates to it rather than duplicating VCS package lists elsewhere.
Gate fails if root quick-start regresses to step_3_grit_state_transition, if master sequence includes legacy closeout steps, or if branch protection drops oya-vcs-admission.
Follow-up gate rejects missing oya-dev-cli VCS command smoke, missing provider slots, and multispectrum evidence without an audit-chain row.
Future agents see one state machine: Oya VCS claim -> work -> verify -> done -> promote. Legacy tools are explicitly compatibility/provenance only.
Agents can now invoke oya vcs claim/work/verify/done/promote directly instead of relying on legacy grit-compatible shells.
Fixed stale promotion-controller test import exposed by the new admission lane; targeted VCS tests now pass.

alternatives_named: Leave grit/icm authoritative until CLI surface exists
Make Oya VCS closure authority now and keep legacy as compatibility/provenance
F6_alternatives.selected: Make Oya VCS authority now; it matches user directive and prevents more legacy cementing.

findings: No secrets touched. Gate reinforces no agent-run git/gh closeout and controller-owned promotion.
Provider evidence slots are explicit and passed; direct git/gh command evidence remains rejected by the CLI ratchet in enforce mode.
Targeted package tests avoid forcing full workspace gates for every VCS authority regression check.

Admission now checks that every multispectrum evidence file has an audit-chain row keyed by change_id; the cryptographic v2 audit-chain kernel remains the signed storage substrate while the existing JSONL row is compatibility coverage.
Changes are spec/doc/CI lane additions plus one test import repair; revert is localized to listed files.
Admission output names authority-check pass and cargo test failures by package/test. Branch protection exposes oya-vcs-admission as a visible required status.
Oya VCS CLI JSON output exposes ratchet status, blocking errors, forbidden uses, and controller action for machine readers.
Legacy tool names remain only where compatibility/source-inspiration/history is intended; forward state-transition fields now use Oya VCS names.
CLI surface moved from planned follow-up to implemented Oya command surface; legacy labels are compatibility/provenance only.
New script and evidence names are kebab-case and scoped to Oya VCS admission.
Updated root hub, AGENTS contracts, master sequencing, multispectrum, GitOps VCS spec, and P00/P01 phase indexes together.
No new durable added under legacy .omc except superseding existing tracked phase indexes; new evidence lives under /evidence.
Provider-neutral VCS core remains in existing VCS crates; CI gate composes without introducing adapter logic into kernels.
oya-dev-cli wraps the provider-free ratchet kernel; no provider adapter logic was introduced into the CLI wrapper.
No new runtime dependencies; avoided PyYAML by parsing branch protection text in the shell gate.
Added only an in-workspace dependency from oya-dev-cli to the existing Oya VCS ratchet kernel.
Changed JSON specs parse with python3 -m json.tool.
Admission algorithm is deterministic: parse canonical JSON, check required fields/statuses/packages, then run targeted cargo tests.
CLI evaluation remains deterministic: parse command, normalize evidence commands, run ratchet policy, emit text/JSON decision.

M1_challenge_assumption.finding: Assumption challenged: waiting for a perfect CLI would let legacy authority keep spreading. CI admission is the smaller, enforceable cutover step.

M2_zoomed_out_fit.finding: Fits master-plan direction: Oya VCS blocks broad Foundry fan-out unless evidence, tests, queue, and promotion semantics are visible.

remaining_followups: Run remote live-provider executions when CI/GitHub/Trivy/Argo credentials and environments are available; local admission now requires provider contract/config evidence.
Migrate the compatibility JSONL audit-chain rows into the cryptographic v2 ledger format once the signed ledger adapter becomes the sole operational audit store.
